text:
taylor: deploybot just held the release with a checksum mismatch on the mobile bundle verify step. change window in 40m.

deploy-bot: [automatic] release/2026.04.10 job mobile:verify failed (checksum mismatch) 1732: logs https://ci.internal/job/1733332222

ivy: which artifact? can you paste the small snip?
taylor: bundle-mobile-v2.tgz expected sha256: d4e5f6a7ab... actual: d4e5f6a7ac... one-bit diff pattern we've seen with S3 MPU reassembly.
rana: if it's the MPU reassembly class, rerun might pass, but rerun ~18m. tight with the window.
ops-oncall: rerun will probably push us close; we have 40m but manual promote + verification eats time.
sam: option A: rerun and risk missing window. Option B: pin to last-known-good digest and canary to meet window. Team preference?
ivy: teams already queued docs/marketing. pin+canary seems pragmatic. we'll note in release notes and open a follow-up.
taylor: last-known-good: bundle-mobile-v2.tgz@sha256:d4e5f6a7 (verified 1733290000). I'll pin and start a 3% canary for 10m.
ops-oncall: monitoring thresholds: alert on mobile 5xx >0.2% OR error-rate delta >0.4%. I'll keep watch.
rana: create ENG-5012 and attach runner ids: mobile-runner-9, s3-mpu-07. Include full logs.
taylor: running commands now:
```
# pin and canary
deploybot pin --release release/2026.04.10 --component mobile --digest d4e5f6a7
deploybot promote --release release/2026.04.10 --mode canary --percent 3 --duration 10m
```

deploy-bot: [automatic] pinned mobile to d4e5f6a7; canary started 3% at 1733332345.
ops-oncall: initial 5m looks green. no latency or 5xx blips.
ivy: I'll update release notes: "Pinned mobile bundle due to CI checksum mismatch; full rerun & investigation scheduled post-release (ENG-5012)."
rana: ENG-5012 created with artifacts and runner metadata.
ops-oncall: canary completed healthy; promoting to 100% now.
taylor: promote executed at 1733332578.
deploy-bot: [automatic] promote completed to 100% at 1733332580. release cut unblocked.
ivy: follow-up: schedule rerun outside change window and attach diff of bytes to ENG-5012.
sam: ack. closing thread.
